sloka: ततस्तु रुधिरौघेण सिक्तं व्यपगतं रजः ।शरीरशवसङ्कीर्णा बभूव च वसुन्धरा ।। ६.५५.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastu rudhiraugheṇa siktaṁ vyapagataṁ rajaḥ ।śarīraśavasaṅkīrṇā babhūva ca vasundharā ।। 6.55.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Then moistened with blood, the dust settled on the ground was seen covered with bodies and limbs.
